# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v2.3.2

一个小补丁：**删掉 2.3.0 临时加的「行动编辑诊断」入口。**

它是为了定位大编辑窗口那几个毛病临时做的取证工具，做法是给编辑器的关键动作预先埋点（记录输入框挂载/卸载、`value` 写入、选区变化、滚动位置，以及每次记录的调用来源）。问题在于：**它只能看到我事先埋点的地方**——事后才发现需要的信息，它一概没有。维护成本与收益不成比例，因此整块删除（模块、样式、菜单入口、测试一并移除，构建产物中不再含相关代码）。

编辑行为与 2.3.1 完全一致，没有任何功能变化。

## 后续计划

插件内会改为接入一个**覆盖面更广的通用日志工具**：不是为某个功能定制的探针，而是统一记录"谁在什么时候做了什么"（用户操作、状态变化、数据读写、思源 API 调用与耗时、异常），出问题时按时间线还原整条因果链。这样就不需要每次为了排查再临时埋点。

## 升级说明

无需手动迁移：数据结构与读写、修订号、轮换备份与写后复核流程均未变化。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v2.3.2/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v2.3.2

A small patch: **the temporary "action editor diagnostics" entry added in 2.3.0 is gone.**

It was an evidence-gathering tool built to pin down the large editor window's problems: it instrumented the editor's key actions in advance (editor mount/unmount, `value` writes, selection changes, scroll positions, and the call site behind each entry). The trouble is that **it could only see the places I had instrumented in advance** — anything I only realised I needed afterwards was not there. Its maintenance cost no longer matched its value, so the whole thing is removed (module, styles, menu entry, and tests; the built package no longer contains that code).

Editing behaves exactly as in 2.3.1; nothing functional changed.

## What comes next

The plugin will instead hook into a **broader, general-purpose logging utility**: not a probe customised for one feature, but a uniform record of "who did what, when" — user actions, state changes, data reads and writes, SiYuan API calls with their durations, and exceptions — so that any problem can be reconstructed as a causal timeline instead of requiring fresh instrumentation each time.

## Upgrading

No manual migration: no data shape, read/write path, revision number, rotating backup, or write-then-verify flow changed.

## Download

Download `package.zip` from this release's assets. Do not use GitHub's auto-generated "Source code" archives as a SiYuan plugin package.
